earliestSignal.contract: The later of the version publication date and the day the affected code was added: a scan against the new version reports it from then on.
earliestSignal.deadline: The latest of the announcement, 90 days before the deadline (Refit's first default alert, pipeline/deadline-alerts.ts) and the day the affected code was added.
earliestSignal.version: None when the registry has no date for the removed version: Refit reports pins but cannot alert ahead of an unknown date.
earliestSignal.daysEarlier: Days from the earliest signal to the UTC date of the maintainers' fix.
earliestSignal.brokenDays: Deadlines only: days from the later of the deadline and the day the code was added to the fix, when the fix came after the deadline.
earliestSignal.codeAdded: The first commit before the fix whose diff adds the affected string (git log -S) in a file Refit reads.
